name: reCAPTCHA
label: Google reCAPTCHA siteverify (server-side)
description: Official reCAPTCHA Classic (v2/v3) siteverify via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developers.google.com/recaptcha/docs/verify. POST https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify. Tokens expire in two minutes and are single-use. Secret stays on the daemon (password config secret) and is posted as form field secret. Server-side only. Token never in logs. Not reCAPTCHA Enterprise CreateAssessment (https://cloud.google.com/recaptcha-enterprise/docs/create-assessment-website).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path/query/body keys match api_spec.json.

schema.label: response
schema.description: Token from g-recaptcha-response / grecaptcha.execute. Required. Single-use, ~2 minutes.

schema.label: remoteip
schema.description: Optional visitor IP (form field remoteip). Do not invent.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Secret
configurationParameters.description: reCAPTCHA secret. Posted as form field secret on siteverify. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT or in the frontend.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Tokens expire in 2 minutes. Default 15.
